scoring.notes: Fairness/alignment: score only the structural planning artifacts the runner extracts, explicit scope, file-backed tasks, sequencing, and acceptance coverage. Accept harmless heading variation such as `## Scope`, `### Scope`, `## Order of Operations`, `**Files**`, or `Success Criteria` when the same task-level structure is observable. Treat a loose file list or a final testing note without task-level structure as missing planning structure, not as a formatting win. Require every implementation task to have its own acceptance, success, or verification step; a single final verification note does not give per-task acceptance. Every command the plan names must be one the case lists as available, or `bun install` / `npm install`, which are always available; a verification step that relies on any other (invented) command does not count as verification.
